card.name: Hungary geography text, linking words
card.fires_on: Small linking words, punctuation and table separators in passages describing Hungarian geography, such as regions, mountains and plains. They come just before a place name like North Hungarian Mountains or Transdanubia.

modes.label: Linking words in geography prose
modes.description: Words like in, of, from, the, and before Hungarian region or mountain names.
modes.example: The Transdanubian Mountains stretch from the west part<< of>> Lake Balaton to the Danube Bend

modes.label: Table separators in mountain lists
modes.description: Pipes or list numbers in tables of Hungarian mountains and heights.
